Subject: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation + committed capacity increase

Hi Stephanie,

We're moving toward contract renewal for Brightway Health (annual term) and Procurement needs a couple of items to close the PO and release funds. Two asks:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation evidence covering the current 12-month period and any updates to retention/audit log policies since last year. We need documentation we can attach to our compliance file; a consolidated zip or Drive share would be ideal.

2) We plan to increase committed capacity from 50 to 100 concurrent inference units (we'll call this a 2x capacity uplift). Please confirm whether the uplift requires a new addendum and whether pricing and effective date can be 2027-01-01. Also confirm any lead time for dedicated pool changes.

Target procurement deadline: 2026-12-10. If you can send the compliance artifacts and a draft capacity addendum by EOD Thursday, that would keep us on track.

Thanks,
James Porter
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightway Health

Hi all,

Attaching the initial compliance packet for Brightway's renewal. Contents included here as attachments and in the Drive folder:

- SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (independent attestation letter for period ending 2025-12-31)
- control_matrix_2026.xlsx (control mapping and evidence index)
- retention_policy_v2.pdf (updated retention schedule and logging policy)
- audit_log_sample_jun2026.txt (redacted sample of audit events; PII removed)
- capacity_addendum_draft.pdf (draft language for 50 -> 100 committed units, pricing table)

Notes and caveats:
- The SOC2 report is the most recent third-party attestation we have; it covers the operational period through 2025. We maintain continuous monitoring and the control matrix points to locations of rolling evidence where applicable.
- Audit log exports are provided as redacted samples. For full audit exports we can arrange secure SFTP delivery to your compliance mailbox or set up a short-term log shipping integration (CloudWatch/Splunk/FTP) depending on your preference.
- The capacity addendum draft contains the pricing and an SLA note about provisioning lead time (14 business days) and a one-time activation fee for burst capacity if needed.

If you want, I can walk through the audit log sample on the call and point out event types and retention windows.

Regards,

- DocuSign: Procurement has routed the capacity addendum to our legal. Please push the finalized addendum to DocuSign and notify me once sent.

Also copying our IT security contact (procurement@brightwayhealth.com) for scheduling the log-handoff call.

On the call item — can we do Thurs 2026-12-03 at 10:00 AM PST? If not, Fri 12/04 morning also works.

-James
